question_text: Describe two differences between inheritance and aggregation, using TraineeAdviser inheriting Adviser and Adviser holding independently existing Ticket objects.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Inheritance expresses is-a: a trainee is an adviser and reuses/extends inherited behaviour. Aggregation expresses has-a: an adviser refers to tickets without becoming a ticket; those ticket objects can survive independently when the adviser is removed.
